content:
I drop my AirPods Pro all the time. In fact, I dropped them by the lake just yesterday. The worst part is watching them bounce on the ground, always worried they'll fall into a storm drain or something. I love having a truly drop-proof case that won't pop off even if it hits the ground. The new ESR FlickLock MagSafe case is designed specifically for the AirPods Pro 3 to solve this problem. It features a secure locking lid and extremely strong MagSafe magnetic attachment.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers covers the latest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your Apple device's wireless charging capabilities.

FlickLock Locking Lid Mechanism

The standout feature of this case is its locking lid design. ESR combines powerful magnets with an internal latch to ensure the lid stays completely closed. You can easily open the lid with one hand by sliding the front lock, but it absolutely will not pop open on its own—I can personally attest to this. Even when not dropped, this means your AirPods Pro 3 won't accidentally open in your bag or elsewhere. It's safe to say this is the biggest highlight of ESR's new case.

Adding a case to your AirPods can sometimes weaken the magnetic connection to chargers. ESR addressed this by incorporating their own magnets into the back of the case. It securely attaches to any MagSafe accessory, staying put wherever you place it.

This case uses a polymer construction with Air Guard shock-absorbing corners to protect your charging case from the most severe drops and impacts. So far it's held up remarkably well, and it's lightweight and portable. The case comes in several attractive colors to match your personal style, and ESR even includes a lanyard so you can attach it to keys, backpacks, and more. You can hang it on your wrist or securely clip it inside a bag for easy access.

ESR Pulse FlickLock Case Conclusion

If you want peace of mind knowing your AirPods Pro 3 earbuds won't get lost, the ESR Pulse FlickLock is definitely a solid choice. The sliding lid design is something you can't go back from once you've tried it. I never thought about it before, but now it's become my favorite feature. If you use a MagSafe charger at your desk or nightstand, this case keeps your AirPods Pro 3 securely closed and protected, fully charged whether you're at home or on the go.

You can purchase the ESR Pulse FlickLock MagSafe Case (for AirPods Pro 3) directly from Amazon or the ESR official website.
